CloudBackupManifest.title: CloudBackupManifest
CloudBackupManifest.description: Metadata manifest for a user's encrypted-at-rest GZIP-compressed cloud backup snapshot. Excludes transaction notes, monetary amounts, and API keys.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this backup snapshot.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the backup snapshot upload.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when the snapshot upload starts.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and status transitions.

completedAt.description: Optional server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when status transitions to COMPLETE.

failedAt.description: Optional server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when status transitions to FAILED.

failureCode.description: Optional bounded machine-readable failure identifier when status is FAILED.

appVersion.description: Application version name that produced the backup.

chunkCount.description: Total number of sequential chunk documents under the chunks subcollection.

compressedBytes.description: Total byte length of the GZIP-compressed backup payload.

uncompressedBytes.description: Total byte length of the uncompressed UTF-8 JSON backup payload.

payloadSha256.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 checksum of the compressed payload.

contentFingerprint.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 canonical financial content fingerprint.

CloudBackupChunk.title: CloudBackupChunk
CloudBackupChunk.description: Single bounded binary Blob slice of a GZIP-compressed cloud backup payload.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this backup chunk.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the parent CloudBackupManifest document.

totalCount.description: Total number of chunks in the parent snapshot.

sha256.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the raw chunk bytes.

payload.description: Firestore binary Blob bytes of this compressed chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on chunk creation.

/users/{userId}/backup_manifests/{snapsh.description: UID-isolated collection of cloud backup snapshot manifests.
Ordered compressed backup payload chunks belonging to a single snapshot manifest.
